about_the_game:
The player is the newly appointed mayor of a remote rural town. You must develop industry, produce a variety of foods and luxuries, and keep the residents happy in a town that consists of only vast plains, forests, and a few fields. Your suitability as mayor will be determined through periodic elections. If you fail to keep the residents happy, you will no longer be able to remain mayor.

The fate of the town's operations is decided by the roll of the dice

The dice rolled each turn determine the fate of the player and their town. Depending on the roll, buildings will produce and process resources, and the town will develop. By constructing specific buildings, you can manipulate the dice roll and take more flexible actions. You can also bias the roll by using special dice that you can acquire newly with each election.

Use over 30 different buildings

Over 30 different types of buildings will decorate your town, including farms, workshops, markets, theaters, and libraries. Each building has its own unique production and actions, and combining them opens up infinite possibilities. Build a supply chain, from basic food production to the manufacture of advanced consumer goods, and aim for an efficient town. However, not everything is free-form. Building blueprints will be selected from options presented randomly. How the town develops is up to the player's choices.

Keep your residents happy

Keeping your residents happy is essential to the development of your town. You must meet the needs of your residents while balancing food and consumer goods. Producing consumer goods that enrich the lives of your residents, such as beer, medicinal herbs, and furniture, is important. Of course, you must not let your residents starve. You must also expand food production to accommodate the gradually increasing population.

Collect Honor Points and make your mark in history

The ultimate goal of this game is to demonstrate your skills as a great mayor and go down in history as an honorary mayor. You can earn honor points in a variety of ways, such as by achieving goals, fulfilling promises, and increasing resident satisfaction. How can you efficiently develop your town and accumulate honor within the limited number of turns? Enjoy different developments each time you play.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 or later (SSE3)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • VR Support: None

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 or later (SSE3)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • VR Support: None

short_description: “Town of Honor” is a town-building simulation game with roguelike elements set in a remote rural town. As mayor, you must construct buildings, produce and process resources, keep residents happy, and win regular elections.
